On October 11, our team visited families whose tents had been burned, leaving them without shelter once again. Even as we filmed, heavy gunfire echoed around us. This is the reality of life in Gaza. Families who have lost everything continue to live under the threat of violence, yet refuse to be driven from their land. This is what steadfastness looks like. Sumud. A determination that is difficult to comprehend unless you understand what it means to face the loss of your homeland. They have burned their shelters, destroyed their neighborhoods, and displaced them again and again. But they have not broken their connection to Palestine. They are not leaving. Sad🇵🇸💔|| Palestine, officially known as the State of Palestine, is a country in the Middle East located along the eastern Mediterranean. It consists of the West Bank, including East Jerusalem, and the Gaza Strip. Palestine is a land of immense historical, cultural, and religious importance, with a history stretching back thousands of years. Palestine is home to some of the world’s most historically significant cities and sites. Jerusalem is one of the holiest cities in the world and is sacred to Muslims, Christians, and Jews. Bethlehem is traditionally regarded as the birthplace of Jesus Christ, while Jericho is among the world’s oldest continuously inhabited cities. Modern Palestinian national identity developed over many generations and became especially prominent during the 19th and 20th centuries. The Palestinian Declaration of Independence was proclaimed in 1988, and in 2012 the United Nations granted Palestine non-member observer State status. Today, most UN member states recognize the State of Palestine. Palestinian culture is rich in traditions including Arabic language and literature, tatreez embroidery, dabke dancing, olive cultivation, traditional cuisine, and strong family and community ties. Despite decades of conflict, displacement, and political division, Palestinians maintain a strong connection to their homeland and a distinct national identity. #palestine #israel #map #maps #fyp
